score_justification: The esp32c3 scored 7 out of 10 due to passing 9 out of 10 fault injection scenarios. The only critical failure was the stack_overflow_trigger scenario, which resulted in a crash instead of the expected reboot. However, all high-severity scenarios were handled correctly, and the QEMU baseline test passed without any panics or watchdog timeouts.

summary: The esp32c3 demonstrated good robustness in most fault injection scenarios, but requires improvements in memory management and error handling to achieve a higher score. The stack_overflow_trigger scenario must be addressed to prevent critical failures. With targeted fixes and optimizations, the esp32c3 can achieve a higher level of robustness and reliability.
